Required findings: Imaging findings include EITHER of the following at the requested level(s): dynamic segmental instability on flexion-extension plain x-rays OR comparison of a supine and upright image, with a difference in translational alignment between vertebrae >3mm between views OR Meyerding Grade II or higher spondylolisthesis
Symptoms include significant level of pain on a daily basis defined as clinically significant functional impairment (e.g., inability to perform household chores, prolonged standing, etc.)

Less than clinically meaningful improvement with EITHER of the following (unless contraindicated) for at least three (3) consecutive months: prescription strength analgesics, steroids, gabapentinoids, and/or nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) OR provider-directed exercise program (prescribed by a physical therapist, chiropractic provider, osteopathic or allopathic physician)
Absence of unmanaged significant mental and/or behavioral health disorders (e.g., major depressive disorder, chronic pain syndrome, secondary gain, opioid and alcohol use disorders)
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.5: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) without Decompression > Degenerative Spondylolisthesis without Spondylolysis

Required findings: Imaging findings include ANY of the following at the requested level(s): Meyerding Grade I or II spondylolisthesis (anterolisthesis) and plain x-rays support progression of anterolisthesis OR Meyerding Grade III or higher spondylolisthesis (anterolisthesis) with ≥50% anterior slippage OR plain x-rays support progression of anterolisthesis OR progressive spinal pain without confirmatory imaging showing progression of spondylolisthesis OR multi-level spondylolysis on plain x-rays
Symptoms include significant level of pain on a daily basis defined as clinically significant functional impairment (e.g., inability to perform household chores, prolonged standing, etc.)

Less than clinically meaningful improvement with EITHER of the following (unless contraindicated) for at least three (3) consecutive months: prescription strength analgesics, steroids, gabapentinoids, and/or nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) OR provider-directed exercise program (prescribed by a physical therapist, chiropractic provider, osteopathic or allopathic physician)
Absence of unmanaged significant mental and/or behavioral health disorders (e.g., major depressive disorder, chronic pain syndrome, secondary gain, opioid and alcohol use disorders)
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.5: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) without Decompression > Spondylolisthesis with Spondylolysis (e.g., Isthmic Spondylolisthesis)

Medical necessity indications.Guideline Category: Discogenic Lower Back Pain/Degenerative Disc Disease
Required findings: Plain x-rays and advanced imaging (i.e., CT, MRI) show moderate to severe singlelevel disc degeneration at the requested level(s).
Presence of chronic, unremitting, discogenic axial lower back pain and associated disability secondary to single-level degenerative lumbar disc disease (DDD) for at least one year.
Symptoms include significant level of pain on a daily basis defined as clinically significant functional impairment (e.g., inability to perform household chores, prolonged standing, etc.)
Structured physician-supervised, multi-modal, nonoperative management of medical care with licensed healthcare professionals which includes ALL of the following:
regularly scheduled appointments
follow-up evaluation

less than clinically meaningful improvement with at least TWO of the following (unless contraindicated): prescription strength analgesics, steroids, gabapentinoids, and/or nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) for at least 12 consecutive months OR provider-directed exercise program (prescribed by a physical therapist, chiropractic provider, osteopathic or allopathic physician) for at least 12 consecutive months
epidural steroid injection(s) or selective nerve root block(s) performed at the same level(s) as the requested surgery
facet joint injection(s)/medial branch block(s)/radiofrequency ablation(s)
Absence of unmanaged significant mental and/or behavioral health disorders (e.g., major depressive disorder, chronic pain syndrome, secondary gain, opioid and alcohol use disorders)
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.5: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) without Decompression > Discogenic Lower Back Pain/Degenerative Disc Disease

Required findings: Imaging findings include EITHER of the following:

coronal plane deformity which includes ANY of the following: Cobb angle >30° OR asymmetric disk collapse causing symptomatic foraminal narrowing OR global coronal imbalance causing head and trunk shift off the midline
sagittal imbalance which includes ANY of the following: sagittal vertebral axis measurement >8cm OR pelvic incidence-lumbar lordosis >15°

Less than clinically meaningful improvement with EITHER of the following (unless contraindicated) for at least three (3) consecutive months: prescription strength analgesics, steroids, gabapentinoids, and/or nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) OR provider-directed exercise program (prescribed by a physical therapist, chiropractic provider, osteopathic or allopathic physician)
Absence of unmanaged significant mental and/or behavioral health disorders (e.g., major depressive disorder, chronic pain syndrome, secondary gain, opioid and alcohol use disorders)
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.5: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) without Decompression > Adult Symptomatic Degenerative Spinal Deformity

Non-Indications: Failure to complete required trial of conservative therapy (less than clinically meaningful improvement with EITHER of the following for at least three (3) consecutive months: prescription strength analgesics, steroids, gabapentinoids, and/or nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) OR provider-directed exercise program (prescribed by a physical therapist, chiropractic provider, osteopathic or allopathic physician))
Absence of unmanaged significant mental and/or behavioral health disorders (e.g., major depressive disorder, chronic pain syndrome, secondary gain, opioid and alcohol use disorders)

Active tobacco use without verified cessation (individual is a never-smoker OR individual has refrained from smoking, use of smokeless tobacco products, and/ or nicotine replacement therapy for at least six (6) weeks prior to planned surgery validated by objective cotinine testing methods (serum, urinary, or saliva) verified as within the normal range for the testing method and lab at which the test was performed)
Important criteria & exceptions: Conservative care exceptions: Less than clinically meaningful improvement with EITHER of the following (unless contraindicated) for at least three (3) consecutive months: prescription strength analgesics, steroids, gabapentinoids, and/or nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) OR provider-directed exercise program (prescribed by a physical therapist, chiropractic provider, osteopathic or allopathic physician)
Multi-level requirements: Criteria have been met in the applicable procedure-specific section:
Documentation required: Operative report from prior cervical surgery
Cervical MRI/CT radiology reports showing neural compression
Physical therapy and pharmacy records documenting >= 6 weeks of conservative care
Objective laboratory cotinine test results (serum, urinary, or saliva) verified as within the normal range for the testing method and lab at which the test was performed
